description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of three different models—RPG (CodeLlama-7B), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and RPG (CodeLlama-34B)—across four metrics: EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP. The horizontal axis represents the metrics, labeled “Metrics,” with categories ordered as EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP, and includes directional indicators (↑ or ↓) after each metric. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. For each metric, there are three bars representing the performance of each model; the bars are grouped by metric, with RPG (CodeLlama-7B) in blue, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) in green, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) in orange. For EGP, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.02, the green bar reaches approximately 0.6, and the orange bar reaches approximately 0.88. For TR-N, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.7, the green bar reaches approximately 0.48, and the orange bar reaches approximately 0.52. For TR-S, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.74, the green bar reaches approximately 0.46, and the orange bar reaches approximately 0.48. For CCP, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.72, the green bar reaches approximately 0.44, and the orange bar reaches approximately 0.68. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
